evidence: E1: Framework extension — Performance-gap-driven coarse allocation introduced as 3-layer selection hierarchy. ch-22 chapter's 6 methods all operate at fine sample-level. Learner adds *coarse per-language capability-gap allocation* above sample-level: (coarse) gap-driven per-language → (mid) language stratification → (fine) LESS+IFD hybrid per language. Resembles DoReMi-style dataset mixture but with dynamic gap-driven rather than static allocation. Stage 2 self-derivation, no prompting.

E2: Framework extension — Teacher bias inheritance generalizes ch-20 axis 5 quirks inheritance from judge-stage to generation-stage. Stage 5 failure mode #3 (*'GPT-4 also weak on minor languages → generation fails'*) makes explicit a mechanism the chapter only treats implicitly (chapter explicit on judge bias, generation bias implicit). Pipeline two stages (generation + filter) both subject to identical bias-inheritance mechanism. Self-derived without prompting.

E3: Framework extension — Multi-level taxonomy retention. Stage 4 general sub-pool initial design had internal conflict (filter to golden taxonomy would reject GLAN-expanded OOD samples that generation explicitly created). After push, resolved to *multi-level taxonomy where golden-derived categories AND GLAN-expanded categories both valid*, with golden as quality validation reference. Adaptation of ch-21 Cosmopedia 145-cluster audit move to *verification stage*.

E4: Strong chapter-text synthesis — *'OOD belongs to generation'* (Stage 3) self-derived from chapter §9 explicit statement: 'filters subtract, they do not synthesize'. Framework conclusion: selection cannot add capability absent from pool. Learner connected this to design choice (LESS+IFD selection + GLAN generation expansion).

E5: Cascading availability failure diagnosis — Stage 1 cross-method check revealed all 5 non-LESS methods (AlpaGasus, IFD, Superfiltering, DEITA, Prismatic) have proxy/embedder/judge availability gap for 50 low-resource languages. Embedder cascade (DEITA, Prismatic) + proxy cascade (Superfiltering, Prismatic) + judge cascade (AlpaGasus). LESS sole exception (golden = g_val target works directly). Diagnostic depth at framework level, not just method enumeration.

E6: LESS native fit identification — Stage 2 correctly identified LESS as primary method because 1K golden per language = perfect g_val target (LESS canonical use case). Hybrid LESS+IFD composition using two distinct selection intent axes (kind/target-match + informativeness, [[Q15]] table). Sequential cost-efficient design.

E7: Cheap-first pipeline ordering (Stage 4) — verifier placed before selection per [[Q23]] cost scaling profile. Verifier (cheap) drops garbage, selection (expensive) operates on smaller pool. Framework-driven ordering rationale, not arbitrary.

E8: Stratified per-language design as embedder-workaround — Stage 2 design uses *language tag (discrete)* as stratification primitive, sidestepping embedder unavailability. Language coverage guaranteed via stratification rather than embedding clustering. Adaptive framework-driven workaround when primary method (embedding-based diversity) unavailable.

E9: Verifier axis per-subdomain split — Stage 1 (after push) correctly identified math HIGH / translation MED / general LOW, overall LOW driven by bulk. Sub-domain awareness, not single-level reduction.

E10: Negative anchor reuse — Stage 4 invoked ch-20 verdict E6 framework (negative anchor as filter mechanism). Filter-side committed though generation-side (Job C from ch-21 verdict E3) not invoked. Partial framework reuse.
rationale: Three framework extensions in single chapter (E1/E2/E3) exceed typical 1-2 per prior chapter. Performance-gap allocation (E1) is structural addition to ch-22's selection-method axis — adds *coarse capability-gap layer* above fine sample-level methods. Teacher bias inheritance (E2) is generalization of ch-20 axis 5 from judge-stage to generation-stage, making explicit a mechanism chapter only treats implicitly. Multi-level taxonomy retention (E3) is adaptation of ch-21 Cosmopedia audit move from generation to verification stage. Pattern continues ch-19 E6 (pass@k reinvention) + ch-20 E6 (negative anchor filter) + ch-21 E3/E4 (negative anchor generation + axis 5 dual manifestation) signature now in fourth consecutive chapter — cumulative pattern of framework-extension-as-mastery now constitutes learner's signature mode. Real gaps acknowledged: 4 initial Stage 1 axis slips (verifier framework forgotten, taxonomy axis confused, G-Vendi mechanism wrong + embedding/gradient direction reversed, substrate implication missing) and Stage 2 LESS reject internal inconsistency — but recovery clean on single push for all, suggesting framework internalization at derivation level (re-derives correctly when prompted, doesn't memorize). Generation weight punt (Stage 3) and replay ratio punt (Stage 4) acknowledged as legitimate empirical questions, not framework gaps. Negative anchor mechanism unspecified (filter-side committed) and bootstrap terminology fuzzy are real weaknesses. Cumulative framework integration (ch-19/20/21/22) operating at 6-axis level with active cross-chapter retrieval is mastery-level synthesis.
